description: This file defines the Model Container class for AOT Inductor in PyTorch, managing multiple models, constants, and execution states for optimized inference.

classes.name: AOTInductorModelContainer
classes.description: Manages multiple AOTInductorModel instances, their constants, states, and execution flow for optimized model inference.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainer
methods.description: Constructor initializing models, constants, and input/output specifications.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the model with given input/output handles, stream, and proxy executor, managing constant folding states.

methods.name: run_single_threaded
methods.description: Runs the model in a non-threaded context, handling constant folding.

methods.name: extract_constants_map
methods.description: Extracts the current constants map, optionally using inactive buffer.

methods.name: num_constants
methods.description: Returns the number of constants in the model.

methods.name: constant_name
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a constant by index.

methods.name: constant_original_fqn
methods.description: Retrieves the original fully qualified name of a constant.

methods.name: constant_from_folded
methods.description: Checks if a constant is from a folded state.

methods.name: constant_data_size
methods.description: Returns the data size of a constant.

methods.name: constant_type
methods.description: Returns the type of a constant.

methods.name: constant_dtype
methods.description: Returns the data type of a constant.

methods.name: constant_blob_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the constant blob.

methods.name: update_constants_from_blob
methods.description: Updates constants from a provided blob.

methods.name: run_const_fold
methods.description: Performs constant folding, updating the internal state.

methods.name: assert_all_constants
methods.description: Checks that all constants are present in the provided map.

methods.name: update_constant_buffer
methods.description: Updates the constant buffer with new constants, handling device compatibility and ownership.

methods.name: update_array_from_map
methods.description: Updates the constants array from the constants map.

methods.name: swap_constant_buffer
methods.description: Swaps active and inactive constant buffers.

methods.name: free_inactive_constant_buffer
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the inactive constant buffer.

methods.name: num_inputs
methods.description: Returns the number of input tensors.

methods.name: num_outputs
methods.description: Returns the number of output tensors.

methods.name: input_name
methods.description: Returns the name of an input tensor by index.

methods.name: output_name
methods.description: Returns the name of an output tensor by index.

methods.name: num_models
methods.description: Returns the number of models managed.

methods.name: get_in_spec
methods.description: Returns the input specification string.

methods.name: get_out_spec
methods.description: Returns the output specification string.
